MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
